Kitchen Remodel Timeline Overview
This 15-day accelerated schedule maps a full kitchen renovation from demolition to finishing touches, compressing typical 10-14 week timelines for a small-to-medium project with pre-ordered materials and a skilled crew[1][2].

Project Context
Dates align with 2024-05-01 (Wednesday) start to 2024-05-15 (Wednesday) end. Assumes standard 8-hour workdays, no major structural changes, permits secured pre-start, and sequential phasing to minimize delays; buffer for inspections built into transitions[1][4][5].
